newsitem.title: USA: CREDIT DEPOT GETS $450,000 FROM NOTES.
newsitem.headline: CREDIT DEPOT GETS $450,000 FROM NOTES.

text.p: Credit Depot Corp said Monday that it received $450,000 of proceeds from the issuance of secured promissory notes due October 31.
The secured notes are convertible into shares of common stock at the rate of $0.40 per share any time prior to the time the notes become due and payable, a news release issued by Credit Depot said.
In addition, the lenders were issued warrants to purchase 1,125,000 shares of common stock at an exercise price of $0.40 per share, the news release said.
Credit Depot said it would require additional short and long-term financing to meet its working capital requirements.
Credit Depot is currently engaged in discussions with respect to such further financing.
